dataset.title: City of Port Phillip Parking Enforcement Patrol Area 10 - Working Street Segment and Restriction Dataset

sources.name: User supplied Parking Enforcement Patrol Area 10 map
limitations: minor streets and labels may be obscured

sources.name: City of Port Phillip Parking Machines
limitations: machine locations do not encode signed restriction type, days or times
dataset states motorists must observe displayed signs

sources.name: City of Port Phillip Accessible Parking
limitations: does not provide a complete kerb-restriction network
does not establish all signed days, times or exceptions

sources.name: Vicmap Transport - Road Line
sources.publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
data_used: road names, classes, direction, locality and unique feature identifiers available
limitations: road centreline geometry is not kerb geometry
does not contain City of Port Phillip parking restrictions or patrol-area assignments

notes: Parking Enforcement Patrol Area 10, centred on South Melbourne between the Normanby Road corridor, Ferrars Street, Dorcas Street and the Kings Way/Boundary Street corridor
The PDF depicts an operational parking enforcement patrol area, not a residential parking permit area.

Missing authoritative fields: authoritative Area 10 boundary geometry, road-side-specific kerb geometry, restriction type, applicable days, applicable start and end times, permit or vehicle exceptions, sign or parking-asset identifiers, effective dates
PayStay zones: 3388, the assigned segment number, then four digits for the side of the road.
